steps: Tab to search, type an unmatched route, press Enter: empty state appears.
Replace search, select a route with the arrow key, submit, open a trip with Enter.
Tab to Close trip and press Enter: detail closes.
Force one trip-list 503 in the browser. Tab to Retry, press Enter: trips return.
Activate Sign in and complete synthetic dispatcher login using the keyboard.
Open fresh synthetic trip 6, enter a four-minute delay, Tab to Save trip, press Enter. Public readback confirmed version 2 and delay 4.
